title: Blessings By The Sea Cottage Seaside, FL
meta_description: Blessings By The Sea is a 4 BR / 5 BA / 12 Guest cottage in Seaside, FL. On the first floor is a sleek, modern kitchen equipped with beautiful stainless steel appliances. The living room has soaring, open ceilings and enough furniture for everyone.
description_expanded: Description517 FOREST STREET3 KINGS, 1 XL TWIN BUNKROOM (Sleeps 2), BONUS BUNK ROOM SLEEPS 4 (2 bunks standard twin)- home sleeps 12 in total*Renovating Fall 2026. Renovating fourth XL Twin bunk bedroom to a fourth king bedroom, adding a full bathroom to the home, and renovating the primary king suite, and new king primary bathroom. Home will be 2,752 square feet. New pictures Spring 2027.Seaside, Florida Vacation With Expansive Porches & Outdoor Living Spaces Blessings by the Sea is a fully renovated Seaside, Florida vacation rental located in the heart of town, just steps from Seaside’s shops, dining, and the sugar-white beaches along Scenic Highway 30A. This spacious coastal home is designed for effortless indoor-outdoor living and offers a rare combination of wide porches, a private courtyard, and an open-air tower with sweeping views across Seaside and glimpses of the Gulf of Mexico.The home welcomes guests with expansive front porches on both levels that stretch the full width of the house. The first-floor open-air porch is furnished with Adirondack rockers and relaxed coastal seating, flowing directly onto a lighted courtyard deck. This lighted outdoor space includes additional Adirondack seating and an alfresco dining table for four, making it ideal for morning coffee, afternoon downtime, or dining under the stars after a day at the beach.Renovated Kitchen and Open Living AreaInside, the first floor features a beautifully updated kitchen equipped with high-end stainless-steel appliances, including a six-burner gas range, a GE Monogram double-door refrigerator, and a dedicated wine and beverage fridge. The open living area is filled with natural light and features soaring ceilings, two largre sofas for comfortable seating, and original artwork throughout, creating a warm and inviting space for gathering, entertaining, or unwinding together.The primary suite is conveniently located on the main level and includes a king bed, a marble ensuite bath with dual vanities and a glass-enclosed rain shower, a walk-in closet, and a dedicated desk for remote work. A guest powder room and a walk-in laundry room with a full-size washer and dryer complete the first floor, adding both comfort and functionality for longer stays.Upstairs Bedrooms and Family-Friendly Bunk RoomUpstairs, Blessings by the Sea offers flexible accommodations ideal for families and multi-generational groups. A second-floor king suite features a private updated bath with a walk-in shower, a large Roku TV, a walk-in closet, and a connected bunk room with two twin-over-twin bunks, built-in storage, individual reading lights, and pocket-door privacy. Another upstairs king suite includes its own private bath, a desk, a walk-in closet, a mounted Roku TV, and direct access to the screened-in porch. An additional bedroom features built-in XL twin bunks with blackout curtains, reading lights, a wall-mounted Roku TV, and a newly constructed marble half bath.All upstairs bedrooms share access to a spacious screened-in porch furnished with multiple seating areas and room for up to eight guests. There is a lounge seating area with sofa, a central bistro dining area for two, and an additional seating area with two club chairs, perfect for morning coffee or an evening night cap. Third-Floor Open-Air Tower with 360-Degree ViewsOne of the home’s most distinctive features is the third-floor open-air tower, accessed by a spiral staircase. From the top, guests enjoy Adirondack bar seating for four with panoramic 360-degree views across Seaside with slight Gulf views, making it a favorite spot for enjoying sunsets over Seaside and evening cocktails.The private rear courtyard extends the outdoor living experience with a lighted dining deck, a charcoal grill, a shaded hammock, and an outdoor shower for rinsing off after a beach day. With generous living space, thoughtful design, and a prime walk-to-everything location, Blessings by the Sea is an ideal Seaside, Florida vacation rental for families, friends, and guests seeking both shared gathering spaces and peaceful retreats—all just moments from the beach.* 5 night minimum remaining summer weeks 2026. Saturday to Saturday 7 night minimum required during Summer; 5 night minimum in Spring & Spring Break, 3 night minimum for Fall, 2 night minimum for winter. Must be 25 years of age to rent and sign the registration. FEATURESSpacious 2,352 sq. ft. fully renovated Seaside vacation homeOnly 528 yards (5-minute walk) to East Ruskin Pavilion, the largest private residential beaches on 30ALighted courtyard with alfresco dining, hammock, and enclosed outdoor showerWine and beverage fridgeUpdated TVs in every bedroom, 3 Roku TVs upstairs in bedrooms, 65-inch flat-screen in living room, full cableEnhanced Eero Wifi throughout the homePeacock Alley Premier Linens—fresh sheets, towels, shams, and coverlets throughout the homeBeach towels for guest useOutdoor Charcoal grillPrivate driveway withh parking for one and designated private parking spot in front of home Access to 3 swimming pools, 5 clay tennis & 3 pickleball courts (fees apply), and fitness centerWelcome tote with two beach towels, a bottle of wine, and two complimentary rental bikes for pickup at the Seaside Transit AuthorityStarter amenities provided and assistance throughout your stayNo pets allowedSTR23-002036
